messages:
Priya (sec): Noticing a spike in keystore.decrypt_fail in ap-southeast-1 after the RBAC refactor yesterday. Some pods failing cert unwrap -> TLS handshakes fallback. Audit bot fired.
Omar (eng-infra): can you paste a log line and principal info?
Li (oncall): sample:
```
2026-04-20T14:00:12Z proxy-12 ERROR cert_unwrap: KMSAccessDenied arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:999999:key/zz-99
principal=arn:aws:sts::999999:assumed-role/svc-proxy-ap/session-12 req=ct-44
fallback=TLS1.2
```
Ned (sre): likely the RBAC PR replaced assumed-role with OIDC SA but KMS key policy still references the old role ARN. Short fix: temporary key-policy grant scoped to the new OIDC principal + region, applied via terraform with explicit expiry. Also increase CERT_CACHE_TTL to avoid downgrade while we patch.
Priya (sec): if we grant temporarily, add incident_id=inc-20260420-ap-ks to audit metadata and include assumed_role_arn/kms_key_id/request_id in logs. Compliance needs explicit expiry and justification.
Omar (eng-infra): temp policy snippet applied (expires 45m). Restarting a canary. deploy-bot: rolling proxy-ap canary v1.9.2 -> v1.9.3 (1/1 updated).
Li (oncall): canary looks good, unwraps normal, no TLS fallback seen.
Priya (sec): follow-ups: 1) sweep key policies across regions to replace role ARNs with OIDC principals or use kms:ViaService + aws:RequestedRegion conditions; 2) update cert-rotation runbook to validate key-policy mappings pre-rotation; 3) add CI test that simulates assume-role vs OIDC flows; 4) add alert keystore.decrypt_fail > 3%/5m -> page SRE.
Ned (sre): I'll draft the postmortem and collect IAM diffs + audit logs. We'll revoke temp grant after 2h if stable.
Priya (sec): thanks — assigning INC-6399 and tagging logs with incident_id=inc-20260420-ap-ks. Ping @here for any recurrences.
